reservation.termsIntro: By making a booking with FEO'S Renta Bike, the customer accepts the following basic conditions:
reservation.terms1: The rider must be at least 21 years old, hold a valid driving licence and have sufficient experience to ride 125cc motorcycles.
reservation.terms2: At the time of vehicle handover, the documentation will be checked to confirm that it is valid for riding the rented motorcycle. The booking may be subject to identity verification and motorcycle availability.
reservation.terms3: The vehicle must be used responsibly and in accordance with current law. Riding under the influence of alcohol or drugs, subletting the vehicle, or allowing an unauthorised person to ride it is prohibited.
reservation.terms4: The customer is responsible for damage, loss or theft of the vehicle and accessories during the rental period, as well as for fines or penalties arising from its use.
reservation.terms5: The price includes third-party liability insurance. Other damage or incidents may be the customer's responsibility according to the contract.
reservation.terms6: A 300 EUR security deposit must be paid and will be refunded at the end of the rental provided that the vehicle is returned in good condition and with no outstanding amounts pending.
reservation.terms7: Payment for the rental, as well as any additional service such as shipping or home delivery, will be made according to the conditions agreed with FEO'S Renta Bike when confirming the booking.
reservation.terms8: The vehicle is equipped with a GPS geolocation system, which the customer accepts during the rental period.
reservation.terms9: By continuing with the booking, the customer declares that they have read and accepted the full contract, available at the time of signing the rental. By pressing "Accept and continue", the customer confirms that they have read and accept these terms.
